body: Dr. Meera, compliance heads-up — DCI revised radiograph dose limits effective 2026-12-15 (Dental Council of India circular 2026-11-04). Maximum dose per IOPA exposure drops from 1.5 mSv to 1.0 mSv. E-speed film passes at the new limit; D-speed does not. Digital RVG sensors unaffected. Deadline: 15 Dec. Main aapke setup ke liye 5-point audit checklist bhej doon? Reply YES.
rationale: Regulation change with a hard deadline (15 Dec); loss-aversion + effort externalization via checklist.
